user_prompt: Historical analogy comparison diagram comparing four standardization cases to AI verification. Column 3 'Electricity Meter (1888)' - shows continuous flow, consumption measurable, no existing billing, verification deterministic. Column 4 'GPU Futures (2026)' - shows compute hours, performance indexable, existing spot markets, verification via benchmarks. Column 5 'AI Work Verification (Proposed)' - shows open-ended tasks, completion subjective, existing outcome pricing at scale, verification adversarially gameable. Use green checkmarks for gold/oil/electricity, yellow for GPU, red X for AI. Show key differences at bottom: 'Physical vs Abstract', 'Objective vs Subjective', 'No prior standard vs Existing alternatives'. Clean comparison table layout.
